contract_freeze.IC-001: A governed survey wave is identified by source_family_uid + wave_uid. Display/native/database labels are attributes or provenance, never machine identity.
contract_freeze.IC-002: Resolve source family first, then family-scoped wave alias. Global bare-wave resolution (for example W1 without source family) is forbidden.
contract_freeze.IC-003: Raw/native source and wave values are preserved explicitly. Canonical display, compatibility key, raw DB label, and UID are separate typed fields; no field silently changes semantic role.
contract_freeze.IC-004: Identity recognition and production authorization are separate. Resolver output carries governed membership; CLOSED_35_MEMBER is required for current production execution. Excluded/historical identities may be recognized but do not become executable.
contract_freeze.IC-005: Every populated redundant identity representation in a manifest/frame must resolve to the same source_family_uid/wave_uid or fail closed. First-nonblank alias precedence is forbidden as validation.
contract_freeze.IC-006: UID identity must be attached before V550 planning/checkpoint/shard execution and propagated through V550, V550J, V551, V551J, V552 and V552J artifacts/manifests.
contract_freeze.IC-007: Active source-wave joins, grouping and semantic scope checks use UID identity after ingress. run_id and country-or-shard exactness remain independently mandatory.
contract_freeze.IC-008: Historical IDs, hashes, checkpoint names, packet IDs, observation IDs and paths are immutable. UID-native logical IDs/hashes require an explicit new namespace/version and compatibility mapping; never recompute frozen artifacts in place.
contract_freeze.IC-009: New physical path tokens must be ASCII-safe and derived from UID identity. Existing NFC/NFD/unaccented/legacy label-derived paths remain readable through explicit compatibility adapters and are never silently renamed.
contract_freeze.IC-010: DB-facing raw wave and governed semantic wave are separate. No code may overwrite the raw DB query wave with a canonical/display label merely to normalize scope.
contract_freeze.IC-011: Permission/governance decisions (question itinerary, active QRA, overlays, production scope) resolve to UID before applying gates. A label miss may never default a required gate to false/allow.
contract_freeze.IC-012: Alias-named authority candidates are all enumerated. Exact duplicate content may be tolerated diagnostically; divergent content for one UID fails closed. Search order is never authority precedence.
contract_freeze.IC-013: Question-structure/binding authority used by execution is portable, hash-bound and exact-scope complete. Green publication requires all 35 governed wave_uids, not merely a nonempty output.
contract_freeze.IC-014: The existing CF-001 through CF-010 contracts remain binding. This campaign strengthens CF-004 by changing the exact source-wave primitive from spelling to governed UID; it does not weaken run/country/shard/hash/schema exactness.
contract_freeze.IC-015: SWID-011 remains deferred. Do not modify V552J solely to satisfy V553 legacy packet expectations; repair the V553 consumer when V553-V558 activates.
contract_freeze.IC-016: Workers never edit this register, gate state, resolution ledger, worker plan, or another worker terrain. Only Vozhd performs governance/integration writes.
